data.body: AC amendment (gap-analysis: implicit_assumption): In cycle-ledger.md, document the extended PR-comment marker grammar precisely: (a) maximum N findings per marker line (recommend 50 — beyond that, emit a continuation marker with same cycle_num); (b) escaping rules — paths/categories containing spaces, colons, or equals signs must be JSON-encoded within the tuples block (already implicit since tuples are JSON, but state it); (c) producer responsibility — name which component emits the extended marker (Story 13 runner.py for CI; Story 14 review-workflow.sh for local); (d) backward-compat parsing — a marker with findings-hash but no tuples is legacy v1.0.0 emission; reader builds cycle entry without findings (only findings_hash).
